Start a Discussion under the target record.

Usage: provenance [OPTIONS] --body <body> [TARGET] [ACTION]

Arguments:
  [TARGET]  
  [ACTION]  [possible values: get, trace, create, update, answer, claim, release, submit, discussions, discussion, discuss, reply]

Options:
      --repo <REPO>                [default: .]
      --scope <SCOPE>              [default: default]
      --format <FORMAT>            [possible values: json]
      --quiet                      
      --stdin                      
      --actor <actor>              
      --declared-by <declared-by>  
      --body <body>                
      --role <role>                
  -h, --help                       Print help
